Before you declare
  1. The CSI field captures how your body and room shape the signal.
  2. You speak your declaration aloud, in your own words.
  3. 13 ticks of live CSI data are captured while you speak.
The measurement — how the room and your body shaped the signal — is computed here, on this page. Nothing leaves your device.
Choose your declaration mode
If you choose SPOKEN + WRITTEN, after 13 CSI ticks complete you will write your declaration. Submitting it adds a 14th tick — your written words are hashed and folded into the chain as additional observer data.
